parsed.why: Totalitarian control leaves no civil space; outed trans visitors face arbitrary detention and possible execution, with documented executions for homosexuality and official hostility. No recourse, no information, extreme severity.

No criminalisation of same-sex conduct or gender identity; incitement and hate-crime aggravator protections exist; society broadly neutral and no trans-targeted violence documented. Thin recourse and no LGR, but no visitor-facing exposure.

2024 law bans gender transition, public promotion and gender-marker changes; Pride violently disrupted with police failure; trans woman killed after passage; hate-crime law unenforced. Active state hostility and social violence.

No toilet or identity criminalisation, but a 2025 propaganda law punishes public LGBT expression; no anti-discrimination law; hate-crime reporting gap; conservative society and one activist attack with no investigation. Elevated exposure.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with whipping; religious laws target gender nonconformity; documented raids, official licence against trans people, violence and impunity. State-directed targeting outweighs rare enforcement against tourists.
